crossRefs.note: They will come with weeping. I will lead them with petitions. I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters, in a…
‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’
Then the king said to me, “What is your request?” So I prayed to the God of heaven.
Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.
For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice…
It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
“ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “For this, moreover, I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will…
I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.
I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is…
“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.
For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

translations.web: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.
translations.bsb: Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
translations.kjv: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken
translations.asv: And ye shall call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
